title: Merchant codes as numbers
prompt: A risk model wants merchant category codes as whole numbers, but the feed sometimes sends junk instead of a code. Write `solve(merchants)` so it returns `merchant_id`, the original `mcc_code` and the code as a number in `mcc_number`.
rules: A code that is missing or isn't a whole number gives a missing `mcc_number`. The job must not stop.
Keep `mcc_code` unchanged as text. Return `merchant_id`, `mcc_code`, `mcc_number`, in that order, for every merchant.
hints: `.cast("int")` stops the job on text like `N/A`.
starter:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
